categories.name: Murukku & Chakli Varieties
categories.description: Crunchy, spiral, and handcrafted traditional South Indian murukku treats.

items.name: Butter Murukku
items.description: A light, melt-in-the-mouth spiral snack made from rice flour and urad dal flour, generously enriched with butter.
items.ingredients: Rice flour, Urad dal flour, Butter, Cumin, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Store in airtight container at room temperature

items.name: Thenkuzhal Murukku
items.description: A classic cylindrical spiral made with rice flour and urad dal flour, flavored with cumin and asafoetida.
items.ingredients: Rice flour, Urad dal flour, Cumin, Asafoetida, Sesame seeds, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Store in airtight container at room temperature

items.name: Ribbon Pakoda
items.description: Flat, ribbon-like strips of spiced chickpea flour and rice flour dough, deep-fried to a golden crisp.
items.ingredients: Chickpea flour, Rice flour, Butter, Red chili powder, Asafoetida, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Store in airtight container away from moisture

items.name: Mullu Murukku
items.description: A star-shaped or spiked murukku made with rice flour and roasted chana dal flour.
items.ingredients: Rice flour, Chana dal flour, Cumin, Sesame seeds, Asafoetida, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Store in airtight container at room temperature

items.name: Kai Murukku
items.description: Handcrafted murukku twisted into rope-like spirals entirely by hand, offering an extra rustic crunch.
items.ingredients: Rice flour, Urad dal flour, Butter, Black pepper, Cumin, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Store in airtight container at room temperature

items.name: Aval Murukku
items.description: A lighter variation incorporating flattened rice (poha) into the dough for a unique airy texture.
items.ingredients: Flattened rice, Rice flour, Urad dal flour, Cumin, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Store in airtight container away from humidity

items.name: Chakli
items.description: Spiral snack made from rice flour, urad dal flour, and sesame seeds with a rich savory taste.
items.ingredients: Rice flour, Urad dal flour, Sesame seeds, Cumin, Red chili, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Store in airtight container at room temperature

categories.name: Mixture & Chivda
categories.description: Assorted crispy mixes, chips, and classic South Indian savories.

items.name: Madras Mixture
items.description: A beloved mix of fried gram flour noodles (sev), peanuts, curry leaves, and spices.
items.ingredients: Gram flour, Peanuts, Curry leaves, Chana dal, Mustard, Chili, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Store in airtight container at room temperature

items.name: Kara Sev
items.description: Thick, crunchy noodle-shaped snack made from chickpea flour seasoned with black pepper and asafoetida.
items.ingredients: Chickpea flour, Black pepper, Asafoetida, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Store in airtight container at room temperature

items.name: Omapodi
items.description: Fine, crispy chickpea flour noodles flavored with ajwain (carom seeds) and asafoetida.
items.ingredients: Chickpea flour, Ajwain, Asafoetida, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Store in airtight container at room temperature

items.name: Banana Chips
items.description: Paper-thin slices of raw banana deep-fried in coconut oil until perfectly crisp and lightly salted.
items.ingredients: Raw banana, Coconut oil, Salt, Turmeric
items.storage: Store in airtight container away from sunlight

items.name: Tapioca Chips
items.description: Thinly sliced cassava fried to a golden crisp with a firmer bite and earthy flavor.
items.ingredients: Tapioca (Cassava), Coconut oil, Salt, Chili powder
items.storage: Store in airtight container away from moisture

items.name: Mixture Kadala
items.description: Whole brown chickpeas deep-fried until crunchy, tossed with salt, chili powder, and curry leaves.
items.ingredients: Brown chickpeas, Chili powder, Curry leaves, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Store in airtight container at room temperature

items.name: Aval Mixture
items.description: Flattened rice tossed with fried peanuts, roasted chana dal, curry leaves, and spices.
items.ingredients: Flattened rice, Peanuts, Chana dal, Curry leaves, Mustard, Turmeric, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Store in airtight container away from humidity

categories.name: Vadams & Papads
categories.description: Sun-dried and deep-fried crispy wafers to complement your meal.

items.name: Rice Vadam
items.description: Sun-dried discs made from fermented rice batter, puffing up beautifully when deep-fried.
items.ingredients: Rice flour, Sago, Salt, Cumin
items.storage: Store in dry place at room temperature

items.name: Urad Dal Papad
items.description: Thin, round discs made from urad dal dough. Frying transforms them into crispy, bubbled wafers.
items.ingredients: Urad dal flour, Black pepper, Asafoetida, Salt
items.storage: Store in dry place at room temperature

items.name: Masala Vadam
items.description: Rice vadams infused with red chili, cumin, and asafoetida for a spiced crunch.
items.ingredients: Rice flour, Sago, Red chili, Cumin, Asafoetida, Salt
items.storage: Store in dry place at room temperature

items.name: Ellu Vadam
items.description: Rice-based vadams studded with sesame seeds for a rich, nutty flavor.
items.ingredients: Rice flour, Sesame seeds, Sago, Salt
items.storage: Store in dry place at room temperature

items.name: Javvarisi Vadam
items.description: Translucent vadams made from sago (tapioca pearls), turning glossy and crisp when fried.
items.ingredients: Sago, Groundnut, Salt, Red chili
items.storage: Store in dry place at room temperature

items.name: Appalam
items.description: A Tamil Nadu specialty papad made from urad dal flour, seasoned with salt and black pepper.
items.ingredients: Urad dal flour, Black pepper, Salt, Asafoetida
items.storage: Store in dry cool place

categories.name: Fried Snacks & Pakodas
categories.description: Golden-fried fritters and regional specialties made with fresh ingredients.

items.name: Medu Vada
items.description: Iconic donut-shaped fritters made from urad dal batter with a crispy exterior and fluffy interior.
items.ingredients: Urad dal, Curry leaves, Green chili, Ginger, Black pepper, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Best consumed fresh. Refrigerate and reheat.

items.name: Masala Vada
items.description: A hearty fritter made from coarsely ground chana dal with onions and bold spiced flavor.
items.ingredients: Chana dal, Onion, Curry leaves, Fennel, Red chili, Ginger, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Best consumed fresh. Refrigerate and reheat.

items.name: Onion Pakoda
items.description: Crispy fritters made by coating sliced onions in a spiced chickpea flour batter.
items.ingredients: Onion, Chickpea flour, Rice flour, Green chili, Curry leaves, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Best consumed immediately or within a few hours

items.name: Mirchi Bajji
items.description: Whole green chilies dipped in a seasoned gram flour batter and deep-fried.
items.ingredients: Green chili, Gram flour, Rice flour, Turmeric, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Best consumed immediately

items.name: Bonda
items.description: Round fritters with a spiced potato filling encased in a thick chickpea flour batter.
items.ingredients: Potato, Chickpea flour, Mustard, Curry leaves, Green chili, Ginger, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Best consumed fresh. Refrigerate and reheat.

items.name: Ambode
items.description: A Karnataka-style thick vada made from coarsely ground chana dal mixed with coconut and ginger.
items.ingredients: Chana dal, Coconut, Ginger, Curry leaves, Onion, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Best consumed fresh. Refrigerate and reheat.

items.name: Thattai
items.description: Flat, disc-shaped crispy crackers made from rice flour and urad dal flour.
items.ingredients: Rice flour, Urad dal flour, Chana dal, Curry leaves, Red chili, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Store in airtight container at room temperature

items.name: Seedai
items.description: Small, round rice flour balls seasoned with sesame seeds and coconut.
items.ingredients: Rice flour, Urad dal flour, Sesame seeds, Coconut, Butter, Salt, Oil
items.storage: Store in airtight container at room temperature

categories.name: Podi & Dry Chutney
categories.description: Aromatic dry powders and chutneys to elevate the taste of every dish.

items.name: Idli Podi
items.description: A coarse, dry chutney powder made from roasted lentils and chilies. Known as 'Gun Powder'.
items.ingredients: Urad dal, Chana dal, Red chili, Black pepper, Curry leaves, Sesame, Salt
items.storage: Store in airtight container in a cool dry place

items.name: Peanut Podi
items.description: A robust, earthy dry powder made from roasted peanuts, chilies, garlic, and tamarind.
items.ingredients: Peanuts, Red chili, Garlic, Tamarind, Cumin, Salt
items.storage: Store in airtight container in a cool dry place

items.name: Flaxseed Podi
items.description: A nutritious dry powder prepared by roasting flaxseeds with lentils and spices.
items.ingredients: Flaxseeds, Urad dal, Chana dal, Red chili, Cumin, Salt
items.storage: Store in airtight container in a cool dry place

items.name: Curry Leaf Podi
items.description: Fragrant dry powder capturing the distinctive aroma of roasted fresh curry leaves.
items.ingredients: Curry leaves, Urad dal, Chana dal, Red chili, Asafoetida, Salt
items.storage: Store in airtight container in a cool dry place

categories.name: Sweets
categories.description: Traditional South Indian treats that blend sweetness with subtle savory textures.

items.name: Mixture Ladoo
items.description: A festive sweet-savory ladoo made by binding mixture ingredients with jaggery syrup.
items.ingredients: Gram flour, Peanuts, Jaggery, Coconut, Cardamom, Ghee
items.storage: Store in airtight container in a cool place

items.name: Ellu Urundai
items.description: Round balls made by binding toasted sesame seeds with jaggery or sugar syrup.
items.ingredients: Sesame seeds, Jaggery, Cardamom, Dry ginger powder
items.storage: Store in airtight container at room temperature

items.name: Cheedai (Sweet)
items.description: Small, round, crunchy fried balls made with rice flour and jaggery.
items.ingredients: Rice flour, Jaggery, Sesame seeds, Coconut, Cardamom, Oil
items.storage: Store in airtight container at room temperature
